What the dossier DOES attest (conf 0.72-0.82, invariant across ALL documented variants): The Writhing Jar spawns 2 HOSTILE worms at the player; worms interact with on-hit and on-kill effects; the build family farms its own victims to fuel proc economies where real enemies are scarce (bosses). That invariant — self-supplied sacrificial victim-entities as guaranteed proc-target ammunition — has NO engine lane: engine proxies are ALLIES, and trigger conditions consume real combat events; nothing supplies synthetic targets. The reactive trigger half (on-crit -> linked-cast) IS native, and PROXY_INVERSION is the nearest door for spawn-to-destroy proxy semantics (capstone family abstained at dossier — single hedged door only). No source facts invented.
